statement: The shadow fleet will experience a significant reduction in functionality due to Ukrainian attacks, leading to a severe tanker shortage and increased crude oil prices globally.
transcript_excerpt: So, what happens when you remove a thousand tankers from the fleet? Well, all of a sudden, you go into a severe tanker shortage, which dries up the price of crude for everyone.
